description: This PHP source file defines the `KmsClient` class within the AWS SDK, used for interacting with the AWS Key Management Service (KMS). It primarily contains method annotations indicating available KMS operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: KmsClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS KMS, providing methods to perform various key management operations.

methods.name: cancelKeyDeletion
methods.description: Cancels the deletion of a customer master key (CMK) in AWS KMS.

methods.name: connectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Connects to an existing custom key store.

methods.name: createAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: createCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a custom key store in AWS KMS.

methods.name: createGrant
methods.description: Adds a grant to a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a new symmetric or asymmetric customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext using a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Deletes an alias from AWS KMS.

methods.name: deleteCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes a custom key store.

methods.name: deleteImportedKeyMaterial
methods.description: Deletes imported key material from a CMK.

methods.name: deriveSharedSecret
methods.description: Derives a shared secret from a private and public key.

methods.name: describeCustomKeyStores
methods.description: Provides information about custom key stores.

methods.name: describeKey
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a CMK.

methods.name: disableKey
methods.description: Disables a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: disableKeyRotation
methods.description: Disables automatic key rotation for a CMK.

methods.name: disconnectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Disconnects from a custom key store.

methods.name: enableKey
methods.description: Enables a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: enableKeyRotation
methods.description: Enables automatic key rotation for a CMK.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext using a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: generateDataKey
methods.description: Generates a unique data key.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPair
methods.description: Generates a unique data key pair.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key pair without plaintext.

methods.name: generateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key without plaintext.

methods.name: generateMac
methods.description: Generates a message authentication code (MAC).

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates random bytes.

methods.name: getKeyPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the key policy for a CMK.

methods.name: getKeyRotationStatus
methods.description: Gets the rotation status of a CMK.

methods.name: getParametersForImport
methods.description: Retrieves the parameters for importing key material.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Gets the public key of asymmetric CMKs.

methods.name: importKeyMaterial
methods.description: Imports key material into a CMK.

methods.name: listAliases
methods.description: Lists aliases associated with a customer master key.

methods.name: listGrants
methods.description: Lists grants for a customer master key.

methods.name: listKeyPolicies
methods.description: Lists policies attached to a CMK.

methods.name: listKeyRotations
methods.description: Lists key rotation statuses.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all customer master keys (CMKs).

methods.name: listResourceTags
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: listRetirableGrants
methods.description: Lists grants that can be retired.

methods.name: putKeyPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to a CMK.

methods.name: reEncrypt
methods.description: Re-encrypts data with a new CMK.

methods.name: replicateKey
methods.description: Replicates a CMK to another region.

methods.name: retireGrant
methods.description: Retires a grant.

methods.name: revokeGrant
methods.description: Revokes a grant.

methods.name: rotateKeyOnDemand
methods.description: Rotates a key on demand.

methods.name: scheduleKeyDeletion
methods.description: Schedules deletion of a CMK.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Creates a digital signature.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateAlias
methods.description: Updates an alias to point to a different CMK.

methods.name: updateCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Updates a custom key store.

methods.name: updateKeyDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a CMK.

methods.name: updatePrimaryRegion
methods.description: Updates the primary region of a multi-region key.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a digital signature.

methods.name: verifyMac
methods.description: Verifies a message authentication code (MAC).
